_notes: Built for baked-in NPC generation in a small-town Ohio-style setting.
Pay and benefit numbers are simulation-tuning defaults, not official wage or insurance data.
JobDefinition describes the occupation. Workplace/job-slot data determines how many people can actually hold the job.
NPC EmploymentRecord stores the individual's real schedule, pay, attendance, supervisor, raises, promotions and benefit enrollment.
Do not put personal debt, bank balance, household bills or commute in JobDefinition.
